title: Crestline Credit Card Late Fee Terms
content:
**Clause.** A late fee is charged on a Crestline Credit Card account when the minimum payment due on a statement has not been received by its payment due date at the payment cutoff time. Whether it was received is measured by the payments posted after the statement date and on or before the payment due date, less any of those payments returned unpaid.

## Limits on the fee

1. **One per statement.** One late fee at most may be charged for each statement; a statement that already carries a late fee on the card ledger takes no second one.
2. **No fee** when the minimum payment due was 0.00, or when the payments received by the due date equal or exceed it.
3. **Amount.** The fee is the product's repeat late fee when at least one late fee — not reversed by a fee reversal — was charged on one of the 6 statements before the statement whose minimum was missed, and the product's first late fee otherwise.
4. **Cap.** In either case the fee never exceeds the minimum payment due on that statement.
5. **No double fee.** A late fee and a returned payment fee are never both charged for the same missed payment: when a returned payment is what made the minimum unpaid, only the late fee is charged.

## Worked cases (hypothetical statements, at the schedule figures of 30 USD first and 41 USD repeat)

| Minimum due | Paid by the due date | Unreversed late fees on the 6 prior statements | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.00 | — | — | none |
| 60.00 | 60.00 | 0 | none |
| 60.00 | 20.00 | 0 | 30.00 |
| 60.00 | 20.00 | 1 | 41.00 |
| 33.00 | 0.00 | 2 | 33.00 (capped at the minimum due) |
| 60.00 | 60.00, later returned unpaid | 0 | 30.00, with no returned payment fee for the same event |
